full_judgment: 11. The learned counsel for the petitioner emphasized that the impugned judgment and decree of the lower appellate court is not a. proper judgment reversal in as much as the object of rule 31 of order 41 has not been complied with. Rather he has gone far beyond the scope of the aforesaid rule 31 of or. 41 of the code. This contention of the learned Advocates appears to be well found.
